source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: That approach will work. We’ll use https://shatterhouse.example as the master website where visitors can learn about your brand and choose a location. Selecting a location like Ridgehaven or Harbor Valley will take the visitor to that location’s own Wix website, where bookings and payment processing will occur. Each location will therefore have its own Wix account, bookings, calendar, reporting, and payment setup, while everything remains connected through the main https://shatterhouse.example website.

value_updates.location_site_architecture: Each operational location uses its own Wix website connected through the master website.
value_updates.location_wix_account_model: Each operational location uses its own Wix account.

routing_warnings.description: The unlinked location button concerns routing visitors from the master site rather than whether locations use separate Wix sites and accounts.
Installing the booking system on the second website concerns location booking placement rather than the separate-site architecture itself.
The reversed master and Ridgehaven site profiles concern content-to-profile ownership rather than the requirement to maintain separate Wix sites.
The confirmed domain connection verifies domain-to-website mapping, not the broader separate-site architecture.
